sections.5-1-why-measure-outcomes: Bina napne ke na aap ko pata chalta hai na patient ko ke ilaaj kaam kar raha hai. Outcome measures yeh saaf karte hain.
sections.5-2-smart-goals: Goals SMART hon: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant aur Time-bound.
sections.5-3-documentation-the-soap-format: SOAP note: S (patient ne kya kaha), O (kya napa), A (aap ka andaza aur reasoning), P (ilaaj aur agla qadam).
sections.5-4-informed-consent: Examination aur ilaaj se pehle patient ko aasaan alfaaz mein samjhayein aur us ki marzi lein.
sections.5-5-referral-decisions-and-writing-a-ref: Referral ki urgency: emergency (jaise cauda equina, heart attack, stroke), urgent aur routine. Referral letter saaf aur mukhtasar ho.
sections.5-6-safety-netting: Har patient ko batayein ke kaun se naye symptoms par foran madad leni hai aur kaise.
sections.5-7-questions-with-answers: Sawaal hal karein, phir jawab dekhein.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
